description:
(Summary from jobright.ai; the original posting may say more.)

EchoStar is hiring an Early Career Software Engineer to build and maintain software supporting its communications network. The role develops scalable applications, APIs, mobile features, monitoring tools, and automated deployment workflows while collaborating with cross-functional teams.
Early Career Software Engineer building cloud software, REST APIs and microservices, Android features, and reliability automation

Responsibilities:
• Design, develop, and deploy scalable software solutions, REST APIs, and microservices using modern programming languages (Java, Python, C++, TypeScript) and cloud platforms
• Develop and optimize native mobile application features (Android/Kotlin) utilizing device APIs, local database persistence, and secure socket communications
• Wrap legacy backend architectures and data protocols (XML, SOAP, SFTP) into modern API abstractions, containerized services, and automated CI/CD workflows
• Build self-service monitoring tools, automated incident remediation hooks, and system dashboards to protect subscriber service reliability
• Leverage LLMs, AI/ML models, and code-generation assistance tools to build intelligent microservices, automate unit testing, and optimize data pipelines
• Write comprehensive unit, integration, and component tests (JUnit, React Testing Library), maintain clear OpenAPI/Swagger documentation, and utilize version control and CI/CD pipelines
• Partner with product managers, QA teams, and cloud architects to refine technical specifications and deliver features across agile sprint cycles

Requirements:
• Java, Spring Boot, Python (FastAPI/Flask/Django), TypeScript/JavaScript, React.js, Kotlin, C/C++, HTML/CSS, SQL
• RESTful API Design, Microservices Architecture, GraphQL, Relational Databases (Oracle, PostgreSQL, MySQL), JPA/Hibernate, Object-Oriented Design
• Large Language Models (LLMs), Retrieval-Augmented Generation (RAG), Prompt Engineering, AI Agents, Generative AI Platforms, Machine Learning Fundamentals, ETL Pipelines, Vector Databases, SQL/NoSQL Databases, and AI-assisted development tools (e.g., GitHub Copilot)
• AWS (Lambda, CloudWatch, EC2, Bedrock), Docker, Containerization, Git/GitHub, CI/CD pipelines, System Logging & Audit Trails
• Demonstrate AI literacy by proactively integrating modern generative AI, automation, and productivity tools into daily workflows to increase efficiency
• Skillfully apply prompt engineering, LLM accelerators, and automated platforms to streamline research, technical documentation, and problem-solving
• Demonstrate strong critical thinking skills
• Exhibit clear written/verbal communication
• Deliver results with full accountability
• Collaborate effectively with cross-functional partners
• Bachelor's or Master's Degree in Computer Science, Computer Engineering, or a related technical field
• Foundational software engineering experience gained through internships, co-ops, coursework, research, or hands-on projects
• Visa sponsorship not available for this role

Preferred:
• React Native, Swift, or Kotlin
